denominators_and_gates.Mach_denominator: sound_speed=20 m/s and U_ref, never a measured survivor maximum

field_conventions.excluded_particle_policy: excluded particles remain in the fixed denominator and contribute to unknown mass; they are never renormalized away

pressure.atmospheric_offset: p_atm is removed by the solver field contract; parser must reject an unknown offset

field_conventions.valid_particle: valid=true, finite position/velocity/pressure/mass/density, and 900 <= density <= 1100 kg/m^3

local_coordinates.origin: bottom-plane origin at x=0,z=0 for the anchor cell
local_coordinates.periodic_images: project each native particle once in the primary cell; never duplicate image particles in a denominator

profile_and_flux.bin_assignment: linear hat interpolation from each valid particle n to adjacent fixed midpoint bins
profile_and_flux.empty_bin: hard failure; no interpolation from future frames or neighboring time windows
profile_and_flux.profile: weighted mean u_s at each fixed midpoint bin
profile_and_flux.unknown_mass: mass of invalid, excluded, or unsupported particles divided by total registered fluid mass

surface_height.cell_estimator: maximum valid local n in each cell after fixed density/finite gates
surface_height.grid: 32 uniform streamwise cells x 16 uniform spanwise cells in the primary periodic cell
surface_height.missing_cell: hard failure; no carry-forward, temporal interpolation, or survivor renormalization
surface_height.normal_velocity: mean absolute u_n at the selected surface particle per occupied cell, with missing cells failing
surface_height.surface_reference: theoretical local plane n=h, not a fitted or time-shifted plane

time_window.frame_selection: fixed TimeOut axis; right-censored or missing frames fail the case
